title: What latency numbers and availability targets should every engineer know?
description: Order-of-magnitude latencies (memory, SSD, network, cross-region), what 99.9% vs 99.99% allows per month, and using them in estimates.

title: How does DNS resolution work?
description: Recursive and authoritative resolvers, caching and TTLs, record types, and DNS-based load balancing and failover.

title: What is the difference between a reverse proxy and a forward proxy?
description: Who each proxy represents, what reverse proxies do (TLS termination, caching, routing), and how they relate to load balancers and API gateways.

title: How would you design a collaborative editor like Google Docs?
description: Real-time co-editing with operational transforms or CRDTs, presence, offline edits, and document storage.

title: How would you design a distributed job scheduler?
description: Scheduling millions of delayed and recurring jobs: storage, leasing, at-least-once execution, retries and exactly-once side effects.

title: How would you design Instagram?
description: Photo upload and storage, feed generation, follows, likes and comments at scale, with media delivery through a CDN.

title: How would you design a ticket booking system like Ticketmaster?
description: Flash-sale traffic, seat holds with expiry, no double booking, queues and fairness, and payment hand-off.
